simple.meaning: חֲזִיז (chăzîyz) is a Hebrew word meaning “a flash of lightning.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֲזִיז (H2385) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 28:26, with occurrences in Job, Zechariah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲזִיז (H2385) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֲזִיז (H2385) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֲזִיז (chăzîyz) / H2385 is traced through Job 28:26, Job 38:25, Zechariah 10:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2385. chaziz [ חֲזִיז ] noun [masculine] thunder-bolt, lightning flash (Late Hebrew חֲזִיז ; Aramaic חֲזִיזָא shining cloud ) — only construct חֲזִיז and plural חֲזִיזִים ; קֹלוֺת לַחֲזִיז וְדֶרֶךְ Job 28:26 and a way for thunder-bolts = 38:25 ; ׳י חֲזִיזִים עשֶֹׁה Zech 10:1 (|| גֶּשֶׁם מְטַרֿ ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to glare;
